summary: Code review (frontend-only, Android-only component — returns null on web, so no browser UI to render). Verified AlertPermissionWalkthrough.tsx meets every requirement in the review request, and confirmed the web customer app still loads without page errors.

code_review_findings.safe_area_bottom_padding: PASS — line 101: paddingBottom: 20 + Math.max(insets.bottom, 16). Uses useSafeAreaInsets (line 40). SafeAreaProvider wraps the app in app/_layout.tsx (line 97). Modal has statusBarTranslucent set.
code_review_findings.auto_permissions_silent: PASS — AUTO_KEYS=['notifications','battery'] (line 17). Loop at lines 58-63 invokes runRequest silently BEFORE opening the modal. Skips when st.available===false, st.granted, or (notifications && canAskAgain===false). Neither 'notifications' nor 'battery' appear in STEPS (lines 20-24).
code_review_findings.steps_only_force_permissions: PASS — STEPS contains only fullscreen, overlay, oem (lines 21-23).
code_review_findings.modal_opens_only_if_missing: PASS — lines 64-69: re-reads states after auto-requests, computes `missing = STEPS.some(available && !granted)`. If none missing, sets DONE_KEY and returns without opening. Otherwise snapshots todo = STEPS filtered to the missing ones.
code_review_findings.progress_counter_correct: PASS — `steps = STEPS.filter(st => todo.includes(st.key))` (line 82). Counter uses `safeIdx + 1 / steps.length` (line 106) so e.g. 1/2 when oem is unavailable or fullscreen already granted. todo is a one-time snapshot (set once in the effect) so numerator/denominator do not shift mid-walkthrough.
code_review_findings.hooks_order_valid: PASS — All hooks (useTheme, useSafeAreaInsets, useState×4, useCallback, useEffect×2, useMemo, useCallback) are declared before the early return on line 85. No conditional hook calls.
code_review_findings.no_ts_errors_in_component: PASS — `tsc --noEmit` reports only one unrelated error in app/(customer)/subscriptions.tsx (PRIMARY[900] indexing). AlertPermissionWalkthrough.tsx compiles cleanly.
code_review_findings.web_regression: PASS — https://merchant-menu-swap.preview.emergentagent.com/api/customer/ returns 200, home renders, no pageerror. Only console noise is the expected 401 on unauthenticated /api/customer/me. Component Platform.OS!=='android' guard (line 54) prevents any work on web; `open` stays false so the component returns null — safe for web.
misc_observations: finish() correctly persists DONE_KEY on dismiss (line 83) so the walkthrough never reopens after being seen.
AppState re-check on 'active' refreshes states when the user returns from a system settings screen (lines 75-79) — only subscribed while open, cleaned up on unmount.

runRequest('notifications') contains a fallback that opens Settings when canAskAgain===false, but that path is unreachable from the AUTO loop because the loop skips it (line 61). Still safely handled for the FORCE path.
requestBatteryExemption() may launch the system ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS dialog on first run; this is a native system dialog and matches the 'silent' AUTO intent in the spec.

critical_code_review_comments: Unrelated: app/(customer)/subscriptions.tsx line 307 — `PRIMARY[900]` indexing fails because PRIMARY palette only defines keys 50..700. Not part of this change but will emit a TS error.
test_credentials: Customer: any 10-digit mobile, dev OTP 123456 (not exercised — component is Android-only and does not render on web).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AlertPermissionWalkthrough is Android-only; verifying its actual on-screen behaviour (safe-area padding over the nav bar, silent system dialogs for notifications+battery, 1/2 progress when oem is unavailable) requires a real Android device build. Code review confirms the implementation is correct per spec. Web export at /api/customer/ loads fine; the component renders null on web by design.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — review request, not a bug fix.
